dct_creator_sm: Harvard Map Collection, Harvard College Library
dct_description_sm: This layer is a georeferenced raster image of the historic paper map entitled: Pianta di Firenze : e suoi contorni, redatta edincisa da L. Balatri. It was published by Cartoleria Chiesi in 1890. Scale [ca. 1:26,000]. Map in Italian. Covers Florence, Italy Region. The image inside the map neatline is georeferenced to the surface of the earth and fit to the European Datum 1950, Universal Transverse Mercator (UTM) Zone 32N projected coordinate system. All map collar and inset information is also available as part of the raster image, including any inset maps, profiles, statistical tables, directories, text, illustrations, index maps, legends, or other information associated with the principal map. Cadastral map showing features such as roads, railroads and stations, bridges, drainage, built-up areas and selected buildings, names of landowners, ground cover, and more. Relief is shown by hachures. Includes index.This layer is part of a selection of digitally scanned and georeferenced historic maps from The Harvard Map Collection as part of the Imaging the Urban Environment project. Maps selected for this project represent major urban areas and cities of the world, at various time periods. These maps typically portray both natural and manmade features at a large scale. The selection represents a range of regions, originators, ground condition dates, scales, and purposes.
